title: Fascinate Textiles IPO Details
intro:
Fascinate Textiles IPO is a book build issue of ₹66.99 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.35 crore shares aggregating to ₹53.94 crores and offer for sale of 0.08 crore shares aggregating to ₹13.04 crores.

Fascinate Textiles IPO opens for subscription on Aug 11, 2026 and closes on Aug 13, 2026. The allotment for the Fascinate Textiles IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 14, 2026. Fascinate Textiles IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 18, 2026.

Fascinate Textiles IPO is set issue price band at ₹148 to ₹156 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,49,600 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹3,74,400.

Affinity Global Capital Market Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Cameo Corporate Services Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Fascinate Textiles IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Fascinate Textiles IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Fascinate Textiles IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Fascinate Textiles IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Fascinate Textiles IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Fascinate Textiles IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Fascinate Textiles IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Fascinate Textiles IPO opens on Tue, Aug 11, 2026 and closes on Thu, Aug 13, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Fascinate Textiles IPO?
faqs.answer: Fascinate Textiles IPO lot size is 800 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,49,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Fascinate Textiles IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Fascinate Textiles IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Fascinate Textiles IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Fascinate Textiles IPO will be done on Friday, August 14, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Aug 17, 2026 . Check the Fascinate Textiles IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Fascinate Textiles IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Fascinate Textiles IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Aug 18, 2026 .
